audience.text: Developers building .NET services, desktop tools, or command-line utilities that need to read, create, or inspect Outlook MSG, CFB, and EML data without requiring Microsoft Outlook or third-party packages.

capabilities.text: Parse and generate Outlook MSG files using MapiMessage, supporting property access, recipients, and attachments.
capabilities.title: Read and write MSG files

capabilities.text: Inspect and construct Compound File Binary structures via CfbReader and CfbDocument with tree-walking and serialization methods.
capabilities.title: Traverse and build CFB containers

capabilities.text: Perform bidirectional conversion between MSG and EML formats natively using LoadFromEml() and SaveToEml().
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Access arbitrary MAPI properties with SetProperty() and GetPropertyValue() beyond strongly-typed MapiMessage members.
capabilities.title: Set and read MAPI properties

capabilities.text: Add recipients and attachments—including embedded messages—using AddRecipient() and AddAttachment().
capabilities.title: Attach recipients and files

capabilities.text: Inspect parsing anomalies via the ValidationIssues list on loaded messages and documents.
capabilities.title: Validate parsing issues

limitations.text: No IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 support; the library processes local files only and does not connect to mail servers.
No TNEF (winmail.dat) support; Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format is not parsed or generated.
No dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar-specific MAPI properties can only be accessed generically.
Requires .NET 8.0 or later; classic .NET Framework (4.x) is not supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic parsing and generation of Outlook MSG files and CFB containers without external dependencies or Microsoft Outlook.
Supports bidirectional conversion between MSG and EML formats natively, without requiring external MIME parsers.
Provides low-level access to CFB structure for forensic inspection or repair of malformed MSG files.
Allows programmatic creation and editing of email messages with recipients, attachments, and MAPI properties in memory.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email.Foss is a free, open-source .NET 8.0 library for deterministic processing of Outlook MSG files, Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, and EML messages, with no external dependencies.

workflows.name: Read MSG file
workflows.text: Open an MSG file using MapiMessage.FromStream() or MapiMessage.FromFile() to extract subject, body, recipients, and attachments.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG
workflows.text: Create a new MapiMessage with MapiMessage.Create(), set properties, add recipients and attachments, and persist to disk with Save().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Load an EML file with MapiMessage.LoadFromEml() and save it as MSG using Save(), or serialize back to EML with SaveToEml().

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Use CfbReader.FromFile() to open a MSG file as a CFB container and traverse its directory tree with IterTree().
